White Orchard Walkthrough

Game: The Witcher 3.

White Orchard is a location in The Witcher 3. In The Witcher 3, early preparation makes travel safer.

White Orchard offers a manageable place to practice movement and review your equipment. Repair worn equipment, prepare healing supplies, and read your current objective before leaving White Orchard. Keep some money for repairs rather than purchasing every available item.

Before leaving White Orchard, repair equipment and prepare healing supplies.
